ابياضضت (form XI)
# اِبْيَاضَضْتُ (ibyāḍaḍtu) /ib.jaː.dˤadˤ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِبْيَاضَّ (ibyāḍḍa)
# اِبْيَاضَضْتَ (ibyāḍaḍta) /ib.jaː.dˤadˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِبْيَاضَّ (ibyāḍḍa)
# اِبْيَاضَضْتِ (ibyāḍaḍti) /ib.jaː.dˤadˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِبْيَاضَّ (ibyāḍḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
